A careful, practical approach

Good decisions start with a clear picture.

During a security incident, uncertainty can lead to rushed decisions. Our approach helps smaller teams establish the facts, understand their options and move forward deliberately.

✓
Evidence-awareRespect the integrity and context of relevant digital evidence.
✓
Plain-language findingsExplain what is known, what remains uncertain and why it matters.
✓
Proportionate next stepsFocus recommendations on your business, resources and current priorities.
Digital evidence handled carefully

Methodical work. Clear explanations.

Forensic triage begins with a defined scope and careful handling. The aim is to help your organization understand relevant findings and make informed decisions about what to do next.

✓Identify the systems and evidence relevant to the question.
✓Separate observations from assumptions and unanswered questions.
✓Translate technical findings into practical business actions.
